dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Je, umeona habari ya leo kwa habari za kiuchumi?
dialogue.translation: Have you seen today's news about the economy?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ndio, nimeona. Ni mbaya kwa sababu ya mabadiliko ya bijini.
dialogue.translation: Yes, I've seen it. It's bad because of business changes.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kwa hiyo, tunapaswa kufanya nini kwa kuwa ni jambo la maana?
dialogue.translation: Therefore, what should we do since it's important?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kwa mfano, tunaweza kuanza kwa kuwasiliana na wateja wetu kwa maneno.
dialogue.translation: For example, we can start by communicating with our customers literally.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kwa nini hutafakiri kwamba hii inaweza kuwa na athari kwa ujumla?
dialogue.translation: Why do you think this could have a general impact?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Kwa kuwa ni jambo la kiuchumi, linaweza kuweka athari kwa mara moja tu.
dialogue.translation: Since it's an economic issue, it can have an impact once and for all.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Kwa haki, tunapaswa kufanya uamuzi wa kutosha kwa hii.
dialogue.translation: Fairly, we should make a sufficient decision for this.

dialogue.text: Nina tatizo kwa simu yangu, hii inaendelea kufungua na kufunga peke yake.
dialogue.translation: I have a problem with my phone, it keeps turning on and off by itself.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Samahani kwa tatizo hilo. Kwa nini unakumbuka kuanza kutokea?
dialogue.translation: Sorry for that issue. Why do you remember it starting to happen?

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Kwa mfano, jana nilipokuwa nikiongea na rafiki yangu, simu ilifungua na kufunga mara mbili.
dialogue.translation: For example, yesterday when I was talking to my friend, the phone turned on and off twice.

dialogue.text: Kwa kuwa ni tatizo kubwa, tutafanya ujumbe kwa kufanya uhakiki wa simu yako.
dialogue.translation: Because it's a big problem, we will make an appointment to check your phone.

dialogue.speaker: Customer
dialogue.text: Kwa haki, nina uhakika kwamba simu hii haiwezi kuendelea hivi.
dialogue.translation: Rightly, I am sure this phone cannot continue like this.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Kwa hiyo, tutakufanya ujumbe kwa mara na tutakusudia juhudi zaidi.
dialogue.translation: Therefore, we will make an appointment immediately and plan further efforts.

dialogue.text: Je, unafikiri kwamba kila mtu anapaswa kushiriki katika kuokoa mazingira kwa sababu ya matatizo yanayotokea kila siku?
dialogue.translation: Do you think that every person should participate in saving the environment because of the problems occurring every day?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ndiyo, kwa hiyo ni lazima kila mmoja wetu afanye juhudi kwa kuwa mazingira yako ni mazingira yangu pia.

dialogue.text: Kwa kuwa ni hivyo, tunapaswa kuanza kuwa na mikusanyiko za kujifunza kuhusu mazingira kwa kila mmoja wetu.
